name: GC Gold Futures — BB + RSI Mean Reversion
description: Mean reversion strategy on Gold Futures (GC) using Bollinger Bands and RSI to identify overbought/oversold conditions. Enters long when price touches the lower band and RSI < 30 (oversold); exits when price reverts to the middle band (20-day SMA). Enters short when price touches the upper band and RSI > 70 (overbought); exits when price reverts to the mean. Uses BackwardPanamaCanal-adjusted daily continuous futures with FirstOfMonth rollover.
source:
# GC Gold Futures — Bollinger Band + RSI Mean Reversion Strategy
# =============================================================================
# LONG:  Price touches/breaches lower BB  AND  RSI < 30 (oversold)
#        Exit when price reverts to the middle band (20-day SMA)
#
# SHORT: Price touches/breaches upper BB  AND  RSI > 70 (overbought)
#        Exit when price reverts to the middle band (20-day SMA)
#
# Timeframe : Daily
# BB        : 20-period, ±2 standard deviations
# RSI       : 14-period
# Rollover  : FirstOfMonth, BackwardPanamaCanal adjustment
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCE
# =============================================================================
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()

# Continuous futures series — stitches contracts together with gap-free adjustment
cont = futures_continuation(
    timeframe=1D,
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c

# =============================================================================
# INDICATORS
# =============================================================================

# Bollinger Bands: 20-period SMA ± 2 standard deviations
bb        = bbands(period=20, stddev=2)(close)
bb_lower  = bb.bbands_lower
bb_middle = bb.bbands_middle
bb_upper  = bb.bbands_upper

# RSI: 14-period momentum oscillator
rsi_val = rsi(period=14)(close)

# =============================================================================
# ENTRY / EXIT SIGNALS
# =============================================================================

# --- LONG: price at lower band + oversold RSI ---
long_entry = close <= bb_lower and rsi_val < 30
long_exit  = close >= bb_middle
long_held  = hold_until()(enter=long_entry, exit=long_exit)

# --- SHORT: price at upper band + overbought RSI ---
short_entry = close >= bb_upper and rsi_val > 70
short_exit  = close <= bb_middle
short_held  = hold_until()(enter=short_entry, exit=short_exit)

# =============================================================================
# EXECUTION
# =============================================================================

# Wire the active front contract symbol to the execution engine
rollover_policy()(active=cont.s)

# Zone-based long/short execution — prevents duplicate entries within a zone
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_held, short_entry=short_held)

# Allocate 100% of available equity per position
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=100)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

# Long entries: lower band touch + RSI oversold
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Long Entry — Oversold",
    icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Trigger",     type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat,  table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
        ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero,     title="Close",       type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details,  title="Lower Band",  type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle, title="RSI",         type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,  dp=1)
    ]
))(long_entry, close, bb_lower, rsi_val)

# Short entries: upper band touch + RSI overbought
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Short Entry — Overbought",
    icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Trigger",     type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat,  table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
        ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero,     title="Close",       type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details,  title="Upper Band",  type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle, title="RSI",         type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,  dp=1)
    ]
))(short_entry, close, bb_upper, rsi_val)
